credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Depicts Catherine O'Keeffe, one of the artist's four sisters. Graphite sketch of young girl (the artist's sister) with a bow in her pulled back hair, facing forward, head partially turned to the left, looking downward. Figure is drawn in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space, some shading against profile. Shoulders and top of blouse lightly drawn. Signed directly beneath lower right of the drawing.
title: Untitled (Catherine O'Keeffe)
